title: Starship Scramble
description:
The Noble Quest 

Starship Scramble is a single player bullet haven ship-building game with destructible terrain and highly customizable builds combined with base building elements. Battle through hordes of the Verde which overrun your home world to rescue stranded survivors and gather resources. They are necessary to build a new home for your people and restore the lost civilization.

Craft The Starship

Expand the flag ship with a huge array of weapons, shield projectors, modules, and crews. Each weapon can be further customized with up to three special-power up that completely alters its performance.

Make Strategic Decision

Orefield and asteroid can block enemies or projectiles, you can actively destroy them for resources or take advantage of them as natural barriers. And ensure recruiting the right people for the job!

A Home For the Homeless

Start a colony, build houses and farms and workshops, enjoy a rest from all the actions. Unlock new weapons and other modules and power-up as you put your citizen to work.

Ensure your Legacy 

The Verde are a diverse and formidable force. Battle through hordes of enemies and destroy all threats that may come to your home world. 

Game Feature• 2D Side-scrolling starship maneuver. 

• 100+ unique weapons, each can be modified with 40+ different Tune-Ups. 

• 120+ Power-up in form of recruitment. 

• 20+ Core ships with diverse twist and playstyles.

• Combat against 50 types of enemies, elites, high-threats and catastrophic level foes.

• 6 Levels of challenge

• Collect resource and rescue survivors to rebuild your lost civilization.

• Expand your new colony and unlock new research.
description_short: Craft a starship from hundreds of unique weapons, battle through waves of enemies to rescue stranded survivors and gather resources - Use them to rebuild your homebase and unlock powerful upgrades. Restore the lost civilization and strive for a new future for the people of Verdantia.
